item.title: After heroic shooting last year, RCSO corporal is demoted in new excessive-force case
item.description: A highly-praised Richmond County sheriff’s corporal who fatally shot an armed man in a justified shooting last year has been demoted to deputy after investigators determined she used excessive force on a suspect last month. item.title: How four men ransacked mail collection boxes at Augusta post offices for credit cards, checks
item.description: Richmond County authorities have broken up a ring of thieves who repeatedly targeted mail collection boxes in Augusta, stealing checks and credit cards and putting local residents at risk of identity fraud. The suspects hit five mail collection boxes over the past few weeks – three times at the U.S. Post Office on 8th Street […] The post How four men ransacked mail collection boxes at Augusta post offices for credit cards, checks appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Few voters, big stakes: ‘Jungle’ primary draws just 433 early ballots
